question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The court __absolved__ the defendant of all charges due to lack of evidence.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'accused'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'absolved'** means** to declare someone free from guilt.**(दोषमुक्त)

 
 
• **Example**: *He was absolved of all wrongdoing.*
 
 
 
• The word **'****accused'** means** ****a person or group of people who are charged with or on trial for a crime.**(आरोपी)
 
 
• **Example**: *The accused was ordered to stand trial on a number of charge.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The meaning of the other words**:
 
• **'Condemned'** means sentenced to a particular punishment, especially death or officially declared unfit for use.(निंदा की)
 
• **'****Attacked'** means to act violently against someone or something.(हमला किया)
 
• **'****Criticised'** means to express disapproval of someone or something.(आलोचना की)
